_about: Strings of the Reports section. Keys are prefixed with reports. so modules never fight over names.
reports.title: Reports
reports.about: Ready-made project dashboards. Built from Jira and Confluence exports into a single self-contained HTML file — hand it to anyone, it opens as a file. What goes into a report is set in the reports: section of the config and in the settings files: the team roster and the event calendar are kept by a human.
reports.pick_project: Pick a project on the Bridge.
reports.gap_roster: no roster at {path} — roles in the report will be empty
reports.gap_events: no event calendar at {path} — the chart will have no bands
reports.gap_cache: nothing in the export cache: the first build will call Jira and Confluence, which needs tokens in .env.aurora.local
reports.recalc_hint: Recompute from data already exported, without calling Jira and Confluence
reports.history_about: Kept automatically on every new build. Useful when a fresh build comes out broken, and to compare the numbers with last time.
reports.delete_ask: Delete the version from {when}? There is nowhere to get it back from.
